parameters.note: Star Lake is a natural alpine lake in the Lake Tahoe basin (El Dorado Co., CA) on the north flank of Freel Peak; its outlet drains via Cold Creek and Trout Creek to Lake Tahoe. It is NOT listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation (§5.85(a)(1)) governs the lake itself — open all year. The Lake Tahoe tributary special regulation, §7.50(b)(152), applies to Tahoe's tributary STREAMS 'upstream to the first lake' (a seasonal catch-and-release window, closed the remainder of the year per §7.50(a)(1)); as a lake, Star Lake is not subject to that stream closure. Star Lake is also absent from CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document, so the empty species/stocking arrays reflect no documented, source-verifiable current fish plant (hobbyist reports of trout exist but conflict and were not authoritatively confirmed).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water). The §7.50(b)(152) Lake Tahoe tributary closure applies to inflow/outflow streams, not to this lake.
